description: List all public holidays for a Gregorian year, emirate and sector, with English and Arabic names, dates, status (estimated | announced | confirmed | moved, with original dates when moved), official source URL and last-checked time. Use for annual planning, HR calendars and to show users which dates are still provisional. Example: {year:2026, emirate:'federal', sector:'private'} → 8 holidays, National Day still 'estimated'. Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.

emirate.description: Calendar profile emirate: federal | abu_dhabi | dubai | sharjah | ajman | umm_al_quwain | ras_al_khaimah | fujairah. Use 'federal' unless the user named an emirate's government. Emirates other than Sharjah currently follow the federal weekend.
emirate.title: Emirate

include_estimated.description: Include not-yet-announced holidays with status 'estimated' (default true).
include_estimated.title: Include Estimated

sector.description: Sector: public (government) | private. Government employees, courts and ministries → 'public'. Companies → 'private' (weekend is employer-set; the common Sat–Sun default is used and flagged).
sector.title: Sector
